contract.hypothesis: For a non-terminal pass that starts at the opponent 30-21 and crosses into the red zone, the first subsequent non-fourth red-zone scrimmage route and its continuation should be sampled from one train-only joint state process rather than from an unrelated generic route.
contract.state_owner: The process owns the handoff from an eligible 70-79 pass crossing to exactly one first non-fourth red-zone continuation. It does not own the crossing probability, later red-zone snaps, fourth-down decisions, clock priors, possession semantics, or scoring priors outside its observed continuation.
contract.eligible_pre_entry_pass: play_type=pass; offensive yardline 70-79; non-turnover, non-touchdown; ending at offensive yardline 80-99
contract.eligible_continuation: first subsequent same-drive play_type in {pass,run} at offensive yardline 80-99 and down<4
contract.state_key: pre-entry start bucket (70-74 or 75-79) × continuation red-zone field bucket × continuation down × distance bucket × goal-to-go

frozen: generic play routing outside the owned handoff

acceptance: Every eligible crossing can route to at most one joint continuation.
The joint process is never selected for a non-crossing pass, a later red-zone snap, or a fourth-down continuation.
The PBP prior builder is deterministic and records its sample/exclusion accounting.
The fixed 2,048-game train-only certification preserves state invariants and structural checks.
